result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A uses the Rye & Ember brand and a warm, restrained light palette. Its labels sit right on the curve, and its peak card plainly says this is the best time to mix, with a note to watch the starter rather than the clock. B is also clean and frames its times carefully, but it leaves out the blog name, has an intro that promises four stages and lists only three, and pushes its main timing explanation below the fold. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B labels Feed and Peak right on the curve and shows the brand name. It also states the key idea twice: in the Peak card ('best time to mix dough') and in a 'Why the timing matters' box that starts within the first screen. A is polished, but its intro says 'four stages' and then lists only three, its stage labels float in a row above the curve, and its mixing guidance falls below the first screen.
